modeReason: The AI-found PHP vulnerability story scores novelty 3 x magnitude 3 x breadth 3 = 27, far above the threshold of 8, so today stands as its own fresh news day.
phrase: AI tools helped uncover a critical flaw now threatening millions of websites. The same week, workers at a major tech company quit over its AI contracts with the military.
phraseAlternatives: AI uncovered a critical flaw now threatening millions of websites. The same week, workers at a major tech company quit over its military AI contracts.
A security flaw found by AI is panicking the internet. Elsewhere, some workers quit rather than help build AI for the military.
Millions of websites are patching a flaw AI helped uncover. Meanwhile, some workers decided a military AI contract was one job too many.

brief.concept: A robot scrambles to patch a spreading crack in a wall built from the internet's code while, just next door, a line of human workers quietly walks out of an office over a military contract.
brief.metaphor: A software security hole is drawn as a literal crack splitting open a brick wall of code; a labor walkout is drawn as workers leaving through a door, with the contract left behind on an empty desk.

cast.who: a robot reaching into a cracking wall built from small code-block bricks, holding a patch tool
an alarm bell ringing above the spreading crack
a small line of office workers walking out through a doorway, one carrying a folded note
a contract page stamped with a small star, left behind on an empty desk

brief.composition: Split scene on a blueprint grid. Left two-thirds: a wall of small square code-blocks cracks open, the robot reaches in with a patch tool, an alarm bell rings above in the one highlight color. Right third: a plain doorway where a few human figures walk out in a line, with one empty desk behind them holding the star-stamped contract page. No text beyond small alarm lines.
brief.alt: On one side, a robot patches a cracking wall made of code blocks under a ringing alarm bell. On the other side, a few office workers walk out through a doorway, leaving a star-stamped contract behind on an empty desk.
